proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ μ _ X n m v hn hX hI hm hv
  have hn0 : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    have : 0 < n := by omega
    positivity
  have hn1 : (n : ℝ) - 1 ≠ 0 := by
    have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
    linarith
  set S : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, X i ω with hS
  have hSfun : S = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, X i := by
    ext ω
    simp [hS, Finset.sum_apply]
  have hSmem : MeasureTheory.MemLp S 2 μ := by
    rw [hSfun]
    exact MeasureTheory.memLp_finsetSum' _ hX
  have hVarS : ProbabilityTheory.variance S μ = n * v := by
    rw [hSfun, ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun.variance_sum hX hI, Finset.sum_congr rfl hv]
    simp
  have hES : ∫ ω, S ω ∂μ = n * m := by
    rw [hS, MeasureTheory.integral_finset_sum _ (fun i hi => (hX i hi).integrable one_le_two),
      Finset.sum_congr rfl hm]
    simp
  have hS2 : ∫ ω, (S ω - n * m) ^ 2 ∂μ = n * v := by
    rw [← hVarS, ProbabilityTheory.variance_eq_integral hSmem.aemeasurable, hES]
  have hIntS : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => (S ω - n * m) ^ 2) μ :=
    (hSmem.sub (MeasureTheory.memLp_const _)).integrable_sq
  have hInt : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range n, MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => (X i ω - m) ^ 2) μ :=
    fun i hi => ((hX i hi).sub (MeasureTheory.memLp_const _)).integrable_sq
  have hEach : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range n, ∫ ω, (X i ω - m) ^ 2 ∂μ = v := by
    intro i hi
    rw [← hv i hi, ProbabilityTheory.variance_eq_integral (hX i hi).aemeasurable, hm i hi]
  have hSum : ∫ ω, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (X i ω - m) ^ 2 ∂μ = n * v := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_finset_sum _ hInt, Finset.sum_congr rfl hEach]
    simp
  have hpt : ∀ ω, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (X i ω - (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, X j ω) / n) ^ 2
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (X i ω - m) ^ 2 - (S ω - n * m) ^ 2 / n := by
    intro ω
    have hSω : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, X i ω = S ω := rfl
    rw [hSω]
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, a = S ω / n := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hna : S ω = n * a := by
      rw [ha]
      field_simp
    rw [← ha]
    have hsp : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (X i ω - m) ^ 2
        = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (X i ω - a) ^ 2
          + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (2 * (a - m) * X i ω + (m ^ 2 - a ^ 2)) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      ring
    rw [hsp, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, hSω, hna]
    simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
    have hq : ((n : ℝ) * a - n * m) ^ 2 / n = n * (a - m) ^ 2 := by
      field_simp
    rw [hq]
    ring
  simp_rw [hpt]
  rw [MeasureTheory.integral_div,
    MeasureTheory.integral_sub (MeasureTheory.integrable_finsetSum _ hInt) (hIntS.div_const _),
    hSum, MeasureTheory.integral_div, hS2]
  field_simp
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (m v : ℝ), 2 ≤ n → (∀ i ∈ Finset.range n, MeasureTheory.MemLp (X i) 2 μ) → Set.Pairwise (↑(Finset.range n) : Set ℕ) (fun i j => ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun (X i) (X j) μ) → (∀ i ∈ Finset.range n, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ = m) → (∀ i ∈ Finset.range n, ProbabilityTheory.variance (X i) μ = v) → ∫ ω, (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (X i ω - (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, X j ω) / n) ^ 2) / ((n : ℝ) - 1) ∂μ = v
